public_source_heads.source_scope: Windows raw-fd API/position semantics, release-level locking correctness, dependency floor selection

exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap first. Then verify the canonical events.jsonl writer inventory is complete and specify the smallest core event-authority API shared by JsonlEventSink, AgentIOLogger, and ensure_project_events_standardized without import cycles. The shared authority must carry candidate011 pre-record delimiter isolation and commit-boundary cleanup. Next map candidate013 regression files, then candidate009/011 cross-platform authority + byte-stable reader, events.lock -> mission-view.lock, PlannerVerdict FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN, and explicit iter_call_events corruption behavior. Keep candidate008 durability and candidate005 provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_014_multiwriter_authority: Canonical project events.jsonl has at least three source-visible append paths: JsonlEventSink under events.lock (POSIX-only cross-process today), AgentIOLogger direct Path.open('a') under an instance-local lock, and ensure_project_events_standardized under a distinct migration lock. Event authority/tail isolation must cover all canonical appenders, not only JsonlEventSink.
run_findings.candidate_014_agent_io_scope: AgentCliBackend resolves its project agent-I/O log directly to <project_root>/events.jsonl; start/complete/error plus usage.recorded, provider completion and budget settlement rows use AgentIOLogger._jsonl_append. Separate AgentCliBackend instances may be concurrent, so their instance-local locks are not a same-file authority.
run_findings.candidate_014_tail_probe: A source-shaped local probe seeded an unterminated JSON record then performed the AgentIOLogger direct append shape. The valid new row merged into the damaged tail and became JSONDecodeError; inserting exactly one newline delimiter preserved the damaged row and made the new row parseable. Candidate011 isolation must therefore live in a shared canonical append primitive.
run_findings.candidate_014_migration_scope: ensure_project_events_standardized scans canonical event identities and appends migration rows under events.migration-v2.lock rather than events.lock. To make its de-dup snapshot stable against normal writers/rotation, the shared canonical authority should cover the identity scan plus append while retaining the one-shot migration lock.
run_findings.candidate_013_settled_patch_boundary: Promote round.review.started to default signal; remove payload-conditional engineer.progress from the durable Mission View event contract; assert every Mission View-handled EventType passes the actual default signal filter with a minimal payload; add default-sink reviewer-active persistence/Web regression and ordinary-progress negative regression.
run_findings.candidate_013_clarification: agent.io.start/complete used by role_activity are written by AgentIOLogger directly to canonical events.jsonl, not through JsonlEventSink signal filtering. Reviewer-start remains affected because round.review.started is a sink event.
run_findings.candidate_012_dependency_floor: portalocker>=4.2 remains the first defensible floor for the inspected raw-fd Windows locking surface; current Argus still declares portalocker>=3.
run_findings.candidate_009_authority_shape: Use os.open(...,0600) for events.lock, low-level Portalocker LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, retry only AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent acquire errors, and prevent post-commit unlock/fd-close cleanup from turning an accepted append into apparent failure. A core-level primitive is preferable so life, adapters and core migration code can share it without a life<->adapter cycle.
run_findings.candidate_011_ordering_revised: Under shared event authority, if nonempty current canonical log does not end in newline append exactly one delimiter before any rotation/new record; never truncate damaged bytes. Stable reading remains byte-based so torn UTF-8 cannot poison later valid rows.
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after complete stable clean scan; UNKNOWN covers snapshot/open/decode/target-relevant parse ambiguity, leaves outbox pending, and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation.
run_findings.candidate_007_windows_bootstrap_race: Mission View reconciliation still needs strict events.lock -> mission-view.lock and a writer projection entry point that does not recursively reacquire event authority.
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
run_findings.control_freeze: semantic work froze on note SHA 7e893018d47b993fe17b3bdad4768d8d8eca4d3f control15/config6. Later note head e39bf32aba5eaff753c79c96e25873abc0d39dbc was observed only for authorized write coordination; semantic work stopped on drift and newer control was not adopted.
run_findings.connector_mutation_boundary: This invocation writes only research_workers_clean_g1/open_source and automation_control/receipts/open_source destinations. No branch/ref/source repository/control/other-worker/downstream/legacy/shared-ledger mutation is authorized or performed.
